title: Register your residency with the local municipality
whatHappens: Once you have a fixed address and a signed lease, you register with the *Comune* (local municipality) to obtain formal residency. Every municipality runs this slightly differently — some accept a simple form, others require submissions by certified email (PEC) or a dedicated online portal.
whoDecides: The Comune where you live — rules genuinely differ from one town to the next, even between neighbouring ones.
timing: As soon as your lease is signed; some later steps (like SSN enrolment) assume you're already registered.
whatCanGoWrong: Using the wrong format or channel for your specific municipality means starting the submission over.
whatKimereDoes: We know how the municipalities we operate in actually handle this — not just the national rule, but the local paperwork — and we submit it the way that specific town expects.
